comment: Chains the Dwarf saga owns. Gnomes walk them too (Shared_Alliance.lua). Text only; every name, level and point comes from the facts.

chains.name: Trouble in Coldridge Valley
chains.summary: Trouble stirs in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh, where Sten Stoutarm calls for provisions and Balir Frosthammer faces a new threat from the Rockjaw Troggs.

quests.task: Hunt wolves in Coldridge Valley for 8 Tough Wolf Meat, then return to Sten Stoutarm.
Kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs in Coldridge Valley, then return to Balir Frosthammer.
Take the stack of letters from Sten Stoutarm and deliver it to Talin Keeneye.
Take the letter from Talin Keeneye and deliver it to Grelin Whitebeard.
Kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps in the troll cave, then return to Grelin Whitebeard.
Kill Grik'nir the Cold, take his journal, and bring it to Grelin Whitebeard.
Leave Grelin Whitebeard and speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
Carry Grelin's report from Mountaineer Thalos to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

chains.name: The Frostmane Hold
chains.summary: Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos sends work to Frostmane Hold and the mountain posts of Dun Morogh, and his report goes on to Ironforge.

quests.task: Explore Frostmane Hold and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters, then return to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
Leave Kharanos and head west to check in on Mountaineer Gretchen.
Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den, then return to Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
Take Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
Carry Senir's report from Kharanos to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge.

chains.name: In Defense of the King's Lands
chains.summary: Mountaineers and Captain Rugelfuss of the southern guard tower in Loch Modan call for the Stonesplinter troggs to be thinned, rank by rank.

quests.task: Speak to Mountaineer Cobbleflint at the southern guard tower in Loch Modan. Kill 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts, then return to him.
Collect 8 Trogg Stone Teeth and bring them to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower in Loch Modan.
Find Mountaineer Gravelgaw in the southern guard tower. Kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers, then report back to him.
Speak to Mountaineer Wallbang in the southern guard tower. Kill 10 Stonesplinter Shaman and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers, then return to him.
Kill the trogg leader Grawmug and his guards Gnasher and Brawler, then report to Captain Rugelfuss in the southern guard tower.

chains.name: Ironband's Excavation
chains.summary: Prospector Ironband's excavation in Loch Modan depends on a report carried to Ironforge and a shipment brought to the dig.

quests.task: Carry Ironband's Progress Report from Prospector Ironband to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
Take Ironband's Progress Report from Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.
Leave Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge and speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
Take the request from Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar and speak with Huldar in Loch Modan.
Leave Huldar and speak with Miran in Loch Modan.
Escort Miran and the shipment safely to the excavation site, then report to Prospector Ironband.
Take the task from Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar and speak with Magmar Fellhew, Explorer Fellhew, in Loch Modan.
Gather 8 Carved Stone Idols and bring them to Magmar Fellhew in Loch Modan.

chains.name: A Dark Threat Looms
chains.summary: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII seeks to learn what the Dark Iron Dwarves are up to in Loch Modan. A clue near the eastern ramp of the Dam is the first thread to follow.

quests.task: Search near the eastern ramp of the Dam in Loch Modan for a clue, and find the Suspicious Barrel.
Take the clue from the Suspicious Barrel back to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII in Loch Modan.
Carry the strange smelling powder to Ashlan Stonesmirk, the explosives expert in Dun Modr in the Wetlands.
Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII in Loch Modan and report Ashlan Stonesmirk's discovery.
Gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear, then bring them to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII in Loch Modan.
Swim down to the base of the dam in Loch Modan, locate the powder keg, and stir in the Disarming Mixture.
Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII in Loch Modan and report that the Disarming Mixture seemed to take effect.

routeTasks.65: Leave Loch Modan for Westfall and find Gryan Stoutmantle in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill. Begin his investigation: seek the contact who owes him a favor and can speak of the Brotherhood's leadership.
